doctrine: LN is a reusable scene/commercial expression; it is NOT a niche or industry.

lanes.name: Workflow In Context
lanes.job: show a real task being performed in its natural environment
lanes.composition: environment legible; action legible; room for copy where useful

lanes.name: Service Interaction
lanes.job: show provider/customer or helper/recipient interaction around a real service
lanes.composition: interaction-first; believable distance/eye-line; no handshake cliché unless semantically essential

lanes.name: Guidance And Learning
lanes.job: show teaching, coaching, onboarding, explanation or assisted learning
lanes.composition: guidance relationship visible; artifact/tool supports the story

lanes.name: Decision And Planning
lanes.job: show a meaningful decision, planning or comparison moment
lanes.composition: focused attention; evidence object visible; avoid fake readable UI/text

lanes.name: Care And Support
lanes.job: show practical support without portraying the recipient as helpless
lanes.composition: dignified agency; collaborative framing; no melodrama

lanes.name: Maintenance Repair And Setup
lanes.job: show human solving a physical setup/repair/maintenance problem

lanes.name: Access Mobility And Adaptation
lanes.job: show accessibility, mobility or adaptation as normal functional life
lanes.composition: person-first; capability visible; avoid pity framing

lanes.name: Digital Task And Assistance
lanes.job: show a meaningful digital workflow, help, security or remote service interaction
lanes.composition: device supports human task; no fake hologram; no readable proprietary UI

lanes.name: Team Collaboration And Operations
lanes.job: show real coordinated work with task evidence rather than generic meeting poses
lanes.composition: task artifacts and role relationships visible; reject generic smiling meeting

lanes.name: Transaction And Exchange
lanes.job: show legitimate purchase, handoff, booking, delivery or service exchange
lanes.composition: exchange event legible; brands/payment data absent

lanes.name: Safety Prevention And Compliance
lanes.job: show prevention, inspection, preparation or safe practice before failure occurs
lanes.composition: correct protective context; no disaster sensationalism

lanes.name: Life Transition And Small Milestone
lanes.job: show practical human milestones with believable emotion and useful context
lanes.composition: specific event evidence; restrained authentic emotion; avoid greeting-card cliché

global_forbidden: fake holograms unless family explicitly requires speculative technology
